text:
Swatch Group H1 2026 net sales: CHF 3,121 million, up 8.5% at constant exchange rates.

In reported francs, sales rose only 2.0%: CHF 3,121 million against CHF 3,059 million in H1 2025. The strong franc took about 6.5 points off the headline growth (our calculation).

These are net sales, not profit. Half-year results came out on 21 July 2026 (figures as of that report).

Timely angle: Swatch Group USA reportedly named Bertrand Delvert its CEO in November 2026 (via Watch Collecting Lifestyle, 3 Nov 2026).

Which number matters more to you, the constant-currency growth or the franc-reported one?

Source: Swatch Group H1 2026 results, as reported by Monochrome Watches and Asharq Al-Awsat, 21 July 2026; CEO news via Watch Collecting Lifestyle, 3 Nov 2026.
